Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely elevated a single conflicting Wikipedia view that listed Charli XCX as host and treated it as the “primary hosting claim,” aligning it with the “British singer-songwriter” cue, instead of weighing multiple reputable sources (e.g., Variety, PMC, LA Times) that consistently confirm Kelly Osbourne hosted the 16th (2014) Young Hollywood Awards. This premature reliance on an uncorroborated, likely erroneous Wikipedia entry led toward the wrong answer path.
